meaningKo: 기억이 나지 않는 것을 다시 학습하거나 되새기다
exampleEn: I need to brush up on my Spanish before the trip.
exampleKo: 여행 가기 전에 스페인어를 다시 복습해야 해.
gameExamples: I should brush up on my math skills before the exam.
She decided to brush up on her cooking techniques by taking a class.
He plans to brush up on his presentation skills for the upcoming conference.
